wages.text: She supports fair wages tied to the cost of living and protecting workers’ right to organize and join unions.
wages.quote: I will fight for fair wages that reflect the true cost of living and ensure that work is enough to support a family.

schools.text: She supports fully funding public schools and increasing teacher pay.
schools.quote: I will fight to fully fund our public schools and increase teacher pay so we can recruit and retain the educators our students deserve.

abortion.text: She supports personal health care decisions without government interference, though this statement does not specifically mention abortion.
abortion.quote: Every family deserves equal treatment under the law, safe schools for their children, and the freedom to make personal healthcare decisions without government interference.

tax.text: She criticized an Illinois budget for raising taxes to fund health care and other services for undocumented residents.
tax.quote: Governor Pritzker just signed a budget that raises taxes in order to give illegal immigrants $400 million of "free" healthcare and $182 million in handouts, all paid for by hardworking Illinois families.

wages.text: In a candidate questionnaire, she disagreed that government should ensure everyone has a livable income.
wages.quote: It is the government’s responsibility to ensure everyone has a livable income. Strongly Disagree

debt.text: She said she would protect Social Security for people near retirement while supporting balanced reforms to preserve the program and limit burdens on future generations.
debt.quote: I believe that it doesn’t have to be an either/or situation. With smart, balanced reforms to our social security programs we can save this program that so many Americans rely on.

schools.text: Her official House biography says she advocates school choice in education policy.
schools.quote: Miller advocates for parental rights, school choice, and an education system that puts students, not bureaucrats, first.

safety.text: She strongly supported requiring and enforcing mandatory minimum sentences for violent crimes.
safety.quote: Mandatory minimum sentencing should be required and enforced for violent crimes. Strongly Agree

immigration.text: She called on Illinois sheriffs to cooperate with ICE and support deportation efforts.
immigration.quote: Today, Congresswoman Mary Miller (IL-15) called on Illinois sheriffs to defy Governor J.B. Pritzker’s state sanctuary laws, uphold President Trump’s federal immigration policies, and cooperate with ICE to deport illegal aliens.

guns.text: She said she would oppose new restrictions on gun owners and favored enforcing existing laws instead.
guns.quote: I believe the best way to curb violence is to enforce existing laws instead of enacting more laws that only serve to undermine the rights of honest citizens.

abortion.text: She said abortion should not be allowed under any circumstances.
abortion.quote: Under what circumstances should abortion be allowed? Abortion should not be allowed under any circumstances.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She introduced legislation to prevent K–12 schools from concealing or supporting a student’s adoption of an identity that does not align with their biological sex.
gender.quote: This bill prohibits K–12 schools from concealing or supporting a student’s adoption of an identity that does not align with their biological sex.

cannabis.text: She said she opposed legalizing recreational marijuana.
cannabis.quote: I support the legalization of recreational marijuana. Strongly Disagree

health.text: She said competition, innovation, and expanded market choices would improve health care and lower costs.
health.quote: Competition, innovation, and expanded market choices will improve quality and lower costs for all Americans.

energy.text: She supported legislation she said would end green-energy tax subsidies and unleash American energy.
energy.quote: It unleashes American energy, strengthens our military, and protects federal benefits like SNAP and Medicaid, ensuring these vital programs serve American citizens, not illegal aliens.

voting.text: She voted for the SAVE America Act, which she said would require photo ID to vote and documentary proof of citizenship to register for federal elections.
voting.quote: This bill ensures that only U.S. citizens can register and vote in federal elections. Over 80 percent of Americans support voter ID, including a majority of Democrats.
